name: AdaBoost
learningObjectives: Understand the AdaBoost (Adaptive Boosting) algorithm and adaptive sample weighting
Learn how weak learners are sequentially trained with focus on misclassified examples
Explore the exponential loss function and its role in AdaBoost
Understand the calculation of weak learner weights (alpha values)
Compare AdaBoost with other boosting methods like Gradient Boosting

controls.label: Dataset
controls.tooltip: Choose a classification dataset to train on

controls.label: Number of Estimators
controls.tooltip: Number of weak learners (decision stumps) in the ensemble. More estimators can improve performance but may cause overfitting.

controls.label: Learning Rate
controls.tooltip: Shrinks the contribution of each weak learner. Lower values can improve generalization but may require more estimators.

controls.label: Algorithm Variant
controls.tooltip: SAMME is the discrete AdaBoost algorithm, SAMME.R uses class probabilities for faster convergence.

visualizations.title: Classification Data & Decision Boundary

visualizations.title: Exponential Loss

visualizations.title: Weighted Error

visualizations.title: Weak Learner Weights (α)
